config_contents.description: GrazFeediNG calibration (process_calib.py; docs/51) against the published pipeline, January-initialized FMAM: the uploaded pipeline as it is (modified-Leung member-wise affine -> member counts -> Identity-Anchored Dirichlet) and each stage on its own.

methods.gf_full: GrazFeediNG as uploaded: modified-Leung affine -> member counts -> IAD Dirichlet
methods.gf_no_dirichlet: Modified-Leung affine -> member counts (the script with --no_dirichlet)
methods.iad_on_mvs: Published amount correction (MVS) -> member counts -> IAD Dirichlet (the probability calibration alone)
methods.leung_blend: Modified-Leung affine -> the published probability stage (smoothed counts + climatology blend) (the bias correction alone)

provenance.uncommitted_check: code and configuration files this result depends on

labels.gf_full: Leung–Dirichlet calibration as uploaded: modified-Leung affine → member counts → identity-anchored Dirichlet
labels.gf_no_dirichlet: Modified-Leung affine → member counts (the uploaded script with --no_dirichlet)
labels.iad_on_mvs: Published MVS → member counts → identity-anchored Dirichlet (the Dirichlet alone)
labels.leung_blend: Modified-Leung affine → the published smoothed counts and climatology blend (the Leung correction alone)

references.incumbent: Published probabilities: MVS -> smoothed counts -> climatology blend
